import glob
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import zipfile

base_dir = r"D:\TigerIQ\Apps\DeXCamPersonal\Builds_v1233"
java_src = os.path.join(base_dir, "java_src")
java_stubs = os.path.join(base_dir, "java_stubs")
work = os.path.join(base_dir, "build_work")
staged = os.path.join(base_dir, "staged")

android_jar = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\Android\platforms\android-34\android.jar"
d8_bat = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\Android\build-tools\35.0.0\d8.bat"
apktool_jar = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\apktool.jar"
zipalign_exe = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\Android\build-tools\35.0.0\zipalign.exe"
apksigner_bat = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\Android\build-tools\35.0.0\apksigner.bat"
keystore = r"D:\TigerIQ\Tools\debug.keystore"
if not os.path.exists(keystore):
    keystore = r"C:\Users\wdragons12x\.android\debug.keystore"

if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
bin_dir = os.path.join(work, "bin")
dex_dir = os.path.join(work, "dex")
smali_gen = os.path.join(work, "smali_gen")
os.makedirs(bin_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(dex_dir, exist_ok=True)

src_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(java_src, "**", "*.java"), recursive=True)
stub_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(java_stubs, "**", "*.java"), recursive=True)

print(f"1. Compiling {len(src_files)} Java source files...")
subprocess.run(
    ["javac", "--release", "8", "-encoding", "UTF-8", "-cp", android_jar, "-d", bin_dir] + src_files + stub_files,
    check=True,
)

# Collect only non-stub class files
class_files = []
for root, _, files in os.walk(bin_dir):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith(".class"):
            continue
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(full, bin_dir).replace("\\", "/")
        if rel.startswith("com/ultracar/dexsplit/ui/TigerIQBridge") or rel.startswith("com/tigeriq/camera/RemoteKeyPrefs"):
            continue
        class_files.append(full)

print(f"2. Running d8 on {len(class_files)} class files...")
subprocess.run(
    [d8_bat, "--release", "--min-api", "26", "--lib", android_jar, "--output", dex_dir] + class_files,
    check=True,
)

temp_apk = os.path.join(work, "temp_classes.apk")
with zipfile.ZipFile(temp_apk, "w") as zf:
    zf.write(os.path.join(dex_dir, "classes.dex"), "classes.dex")

print("3. Disassembling classes.dex to smali...")
subprocess.run(["java", "-jar", apktool_jar, "d", temp_apk, "-o", smali_gen, "-f"], check=True)

# Clean old DexShotQuickButton*.smali in staged
v44_dir = os.path.join(staged, "smali", "com", "tigeriq", "v44")
for old_f in glob.glob(os.path.join(v44_dir, "DexShotQuickButton*.smali")):
    os.remove(old_f)

# Copy generated smali files
gen_smali_root = os.path.join(smali_gen, "smali")
copied = 0
for root, _, files in os.walk(gen_smali_root):
    for f in files:
        if f.endswith(".smali"):
            rel_dir = os.path.relpath(root, gen_smali_root)
            dst_dir = os.path.join(staged, "smali", rel_dir)
            os.makedirs(dst_dir, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(os.path.join(root, f), os.path.join(dst_dir, f))
            copied += 1
print(f"   Copied {copied} smali files into staged.")

unsigned_apk = os.path.join(base_dir, "UltraCar_v1.2.33-unsigned.apk")
aligned_apk = os.path.join(base_dir, "UltraCar_v1.2.33-aligned.apk")
signed_apk = os.path.join(base_dir, "UltraCar_v1.2.33.apk")

for p in (unsigned_apk, aligned_apk, signed_apk):
    if os.path.exists(p):
        os.remove(p)

print("4. Building APK with apktool...")
subprocess.run(["java", "-jar", apktool_jar, "b", staged, "-o", unsigned_apk], check=True)

print("5. ZipAligning...")
subprocess.run([zipalign_exe, "-p", "-f", "4", unsigned_apk, aligned_apk], check=True)

print("6. Signing APK...")
subprocess.run(
    [
        "cmd.exe", "/c", apksigner_bat, "sign",
        "--ks", keystore,
        "--ks-pass", "pass:android",
        "--ks-key-alias", "androiddebugkey",
        "--key-pass", "pass:android",
        "--out", signed_apk,
        aligned_apk,
    ],
    check=True,
)

print("7. Verifying APK signature...")
res = subprocess.run(["cmd.exe", "/c", apksigner_bat, "verify", "--verbose", "--print-certs", signed_apk], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
print(res.stdout)
print("BUILD SUCCESS:", signed_apk, "Size:", os.path.getsize(signed_apk))
